# Lobby environment

`orbital-hangar.png` was generated with the built-in imagegen tool using the user's supplied hangar screenshot as composition inspiration. It is a static environment image; soldiers, platform, patrol craft, dust and weapon previews are rendered separately in Three.js. No external model files are used.

## Generation prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic cinematic environment backdrop for an interactive sci-fi FPS lobby. Reference image is visual inspiration for heavy industrial hangar architecture and wide cinematic framing. Generate a brand new 16:9 image. Camera at human chest height inside a vast dark gunmetal orbital spaceship hangar. Massive panoramic angular window spans center, overlooking the curved luminous pale-blue limb of a richly textured planet, stars, and a detailed large naval spacecraft to the upper right outside. Window has substantial metallic architectural beams, ceiling conduits, restrained cyan edge lights. Lower half is a broad empty dark metallic deck with subtle radial platform markings and physically plausible reflections. Keep middle foreground EMPTY for four real-time 3D soldiers which will be added in code. Premium AAA military sci-fi art direction, dramatic soft volumetric side light, blue-grey desaturated metals, extremely detailed believable surface wear, cinematic contrast, realistic perspective. Leave darker negative space left and right for UI. No people, no soldiers, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Not cartoon, no excessive neon. Wide lens but no fisheye.
